fields.name: person
fields.description: The id of the person in the people register.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind of identity: `github` the GitHub login the collected files count the person under (at most one per person), `github-alias` a further GitHub account, `email` a commit address, `name` a spelling of the name, `svn` a Subversion or CVS user, `irc` an IRC nick, `discourse` a handle on community.plone.org; the collectors read only `github`, `github-alias`, `email` and `name`, so `svn`, `irc` and `discourse` are for the record, and a Subversion commit is linked by an `email` identity.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The login, address, spelling or handle as it appears in the data; a login with the case it has on GitHub.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The id of the source in the source register that connects the person to the value. Required, except for an early commit address whose notes say what it rests on.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: The words of the source that make the connection, verbatim from its excerpt; empty when no quote was verified.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text remarks: what the source shows, in our words, and other records.
